name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: Terrain-aware wintry forecast using ECMWF vertical profiles and Windy local terrain. v21 is the feature-complete terrain-aware winter forecast: next-event intelligence, confidence, event timeline, elevation impacts and snow by elevation, saved-place outlooks, Metric/Imperial units, model freshness, persistent preferences, hazard emphasis and detailed sounding inspection.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
